title: Universal Message Schema
description: The standardized packet for all inter-service communication in Athena OS.

message_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific message

correlation_id.description: Used to trace a request through multiple services (matches the initiating event/command)

project_id.description: The ID of the novel/project this message pertains to

sender.description: The ID of the Service or Component sending the message (e.g., SRV-017)

receiver.description: The intended recipient, or 'EventBus' for broadcast

capability.description: The specific capability being requested or fulfilled

payload.description: The actual data (e.g., the Chapter text, the Story Bible fragment)
